multiple_testing: Holm-Bonferroni across the 5 primary p-values only
heterogeneity_rule: material if Breslow-Day-Tarone p < 0.05 AND max stratum OR / min stratum OR > 2

sensitivity_samples.S2: one order per customer_unique_id: earliest order_purchase_timestamp, ties by order_id
sensitivity_samples.S3: exclude orders whose review_id is shared with another order (review_shared_across_orders == 1)
sensitivity_samples.S4: S1 and S3, then S2 within that subset
